newsitem.title: USA: First Federal Capital sets stock buyback.
newsitem.headline: First Federal Capital sets stock buyback.

text.p: First Federal Capital Corp said Thursday its board authorized a stock repurchase of up to 306,351 shares, or about five percent of the outstanding common stock.
The repurchases will occur from time to time in open-market transactions during the next 12 months, and shares held in treasury for general corporate purposes.
A similar repurchase plan was approved last year, authorizing the company to buy up to 328,000 shares.

Only 224,300 of these shares have been purchased to date, and First Federal has extended the 1996 plan to purchase the remaining 103,700 shares during the next 12 months in addition to the 306,351 shares under the 1997 plan.
